question.text: Which of the following documents is NOT accepted as Proof of Address (PoA) for mutual fund KYC?

answer.text: Employee ID card issued by a private company

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook's accepted OVD/address documents include passport, Aadhaar possession proof, voter ID, NREGA job card, NPR letter, utility bills, tax receipts, PPOs and specified accommodation allotment letters. A regular private-company employee ID card is not on the list and is not accepted as PoA. The Trap: Specified accommodation allotment letters are accepted, but only from government, statutory authority, PSU, scheduled commercial bank, financial institution or listed-company employers. A general employee ID — even from a private employer — is not the same thing. Note: Do not extend the accommodation-letter category beyond the employers the workbook lists. Treat any non-listed category, including private MNCs not on the workbook's list, as outside the PoA framework.
